Name: Shealtiel
Summary: Shealtiel, father of Zerubbabel, is named in Haggai as the father of the governor who led the returned exiles. Through Zerubbabel, Shealtiel stands in the royal line that Matthew's genealogy traces to Christ.
KeyStory: Shealtiel's son Zerubbabel governed the returned exiles and, with Joshua the high priest, led the rebuilding of the Temple.
KeyVerses: Haggai 1:1; Haggai 2:2; Ezra 3:2; Ezra 3:8; Ezra 5:2; Nehemiah 12:1
LifeLesson: Shealtiel never held office himself, but his son did — and through that son, the royal line ran on to Christ. God builds His purposes through fathers, not only through kings.
RelatedEvents: Rebuilding of the Temple; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
